<DOCSTRING>
Binds a value to a signed payload using the serializer and asserts the deserialization matches the original value and timestamp.

Args:
    serializer (object): The serializer used for encoding and decoding.
    value (any): The value to be signed and encoded.
    ts (int): The timestamp to be included in the signed payload.

Returns:
    void: Ensures the deserialization matches the original value and timestamp, narrowing the type.
</DOCSTRING>
